definitions.explanation: A self-service store selling food and household items. Short for スーパーマーケット.

examples.japanese: スーパーで{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought vegetables at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: このスーパーは{夜|よる}10{時|じ}まで{開|あ}いています。
examples.english: This supermarket is open until 10 PM.

examples.japanese: スーパーは{駅|えき}の{隣|となり}にあります。
examples.english: The supermarket is next to the station.

notes: スーパー is the shortened form of スーパーマーケット (supermarket). Japanese supermarkets often have discounts on prepared foods (弁当, 惣菜) in the evening before closing. Major chains include AEON and Life.
